title: Worker Exit Signal
description: Schema for the 2-line exit signal a worker emits at end of invocation. Parsed by run_iteration.py. The structured state in .state/project.json is the canonical source of truth for lifecycle; this signal carries only the worker's verdict bit and a human-readable summary that isn't derivable from state.

exit_code.description: 0 = normal completion (runner reads .state/project.json for next dispatch). 2 = escalate (judgment-based halt or health-check tripped).

reason.description: One-line human-readable summary of what happened. Surfaces in summary.log and downstream UIs (codexbot /run replies, operator tail).
